definitions.full: H6533. param [ מָּרַם ] verb tear, rend garment (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic chop up onions, etc. (Landberg Prov.421 ); Syriac cut, rend ); — always with ׃בְּגָדִים Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְרֹם Lev 21:10 (H), 2 masculine plural תִּפְרֹ֑מוּ 10:6 (P); Passive participle plural מְּרֻמִים 13:45 (P).
